capabilities: Sync the vault two ways with a Google Drive folder
Link phones to the account via an encrypted setup token
Sync with a Drive folder someone shared with you
Keep both versions as conflict copies when a note changes on two devices
Stop syncing and warn when many files disappear at once
extras: Free, no payments or tracking. Requires a one-time manual Google Cloud setup (about 15 minutes); Google shows an unverified-app warning on first sign-in because the OAuth client is the user's own. Android is untested; Docs/Sheets/Slides files are skipped; do not combine with iCloud Drive or another sync service on the same vault.
problem: Keeping the same vault consistent across devices normally requires a paid sync service or risky manual copies; this uses a Google account you already have.

relations.evidence: Your notes now sync to a Google Drive folder with the same name as your vault.

requires.name: Your own Google Cloud OAuth client ID and secret

summary: Two-way vault sync to your own Google Drive using your own Google OAuth credentials, with conflict copies and deletion safeguards.
